
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lvwangshuOI/p/23392231" title="发布于 2026-10-21 21:17">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">CF1882D Tree XOR 题解</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="cf1882d-tree-xor-题解"><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/CF1882D" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">CF1882D Tree XOR</a> 题解</h1>
<h2 id="题目大意">题目大意</h2>
<p>给定一棵 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 个点的树，点 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 上有权值 <span class="math inline">\(a_i\)</span>（<span class="math inline">\(0 \le a_i &lt; 2^{20}\)</span>）。以 <span class="math inline">\(r\)</span> 为根时，一次操作为：任选顶点 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 与非负整数 <span class="math inline">\(c\)</span>，把 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 的子树（相对根 <span class="math inline">\(r\)</span> 而言）中所有点的权值异或上 <span class="math inline">\(c\)</span>，代价为 <span class="math inline">\(s_v \cdot c\)</span>，其中 <span class="math inline">\(s_v\)</span> 是该子树的顶点数。要求通过若干次操作使所有点权值相等，最小总代价记为 <span class="math inline">\(m_r\)</span>。对每个 <span class="math inline">\(r\)</span> 输出 <span class="math inline">\(m_1, m_2, \dots, m_n\)</span>。</p>
<h2 id="固定根时">固定根时</h2>
<p>先把根 <span class="math inline">\(r\)</span> 固定，分析合法操作序列的结构。</p>
<blockquote>
<h3 id="引理合并不亏每个顶点至多施法一次">引理（合并不亏）：每个顶点至多施法一次</h3>
</blockquote>
<p>设对同一顶点 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 施法了 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 次，参数为 <span class="math inline">\(c_1, \dots, c_k\)</span>。由于<strong>异或可交换、可结合</strong>，这 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 次施法的总效果等同于施法一次 <span class="math inline">\(c = c_1 \oplus c_2 \oplus \cdots \oplus c_k\)</span>。</p>
<p>代价，<strong>异或是"无进位加法"</strong>，故 <span class="math inline">\(x \oplus y \le x + y\)</span>，归纳可得</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(s_v \cdot (c_1 \oplus c_2 \oplus \cdots \oplus c_k) \le s_v \cdot (c_1 + c_2 + \cdots + c_k)\)</span></p>
<p>即<strong>合并成一次操作代价不增</strong>。因此下文假设每个顶点 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 只施法一次，设其异或量为 <span class="math inline">\(x_v \ge 0\)</span>（<span class="math inline">\(x_v = 0\)</span> 表示不施法）。</p>
<blockquote>
<h3 id="引理强制性非根顶点的施法量被唯一确定">引理（强制性）：非根顶点的施法量被唯一确定</h3>
</blockquote>
<p>设最终所有点的共同值为 <span class="math inline">\(T\)</span>。记 <span class="math inline">\(P(v)\)</span> 为根到 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 的路径上所有顶点（含端点）的 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 值之异或。由于恰好是这些祖先（含自身）的施法影响了 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span>，点 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 的最终值为</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(a_v \oplus P(v) = T \quad (\forall v)\)</span></p>
<p>任取非根点 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span>，设其父为 <span class="math inline">\(p\)</span>。把 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 与 <span class="math inline">\(p\)</span> 的等式相异或，注意 <span class="math inline">\(P(v) = P(p) \oplus x_v\)</span>，得</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(a_v \oplus a_p \oplus x_v = 0 \quad \Longrightarrow \quad x_v = a_v \oplus a_p\)</span></p>
<p><strong><span class="math inline">\(T\)</span> 被消去了</strong>说明每个非根点的施法量与目标值无关，是被强制确定的。</p>
<h3 id="-的闭式"><span class="math inline">\(m_r\)</span> 的闭式</h3>
<p>总代价为</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\sum_{v \ne r} s_v \cdot (a_v \oplus a_{par(v)}) + n \cdot x_r\)</span></p>
<p>其中第二项只有 <span class="math inline">\(x_r\)</span> 是自由的，取 <span class="math inline">\(x_r = 0\)</span> 最优。于是</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(m_r = \sum_{v \ne r} s_v \cdot (a_v \oplus a_{par(v)})\)</span></p>
<p>且最优方案下所有点最终都等于 <span class="math inline">\(a_r\)</span>（根处根本不用施法）。</p>
<h2 id="换根-dp">换根 DP</h2>
<p>上式若对每个根分别计算是 <span class="math inline">\(O(n^2)\)</span>。把求和改写成<strong>边的视角</strong>：</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(m_r = \sum_{e=(u,w)} (a_u \oplus a_w) \cdot \big|\text{删去 } e \text{ 后不包含 } r \text{ 的连通块}\big|\)</span></p>
<p>根从 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 移到相邻点 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 时，考虑任意边 <span class="math inline">\(e' \ne (u,v)\)</span>——<span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 与 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 在 <span class="math inline">\(T - e'\)</span> 中位于<strong>同一连通块</strong>（<span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 到 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 的路径不经过 <span class="math inline">\(e'\)</span>），所以 <span class="math inline">\(e'\)</span> 的"不含根的一侧"不变，贡献不变。<strong>唯一变化的只有边 <span class="math inline">\((u,v)\)</span> 自己</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>以 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 为根：贡献为 <span class="math inline">\(s_v \cdot d\)</span>，其中 <span class="math inline">\(d = a_u \oplus a_v\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(s_v\)</span> 是以 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 为根时 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 的子树大小</li>
<li>以 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 为根：不含 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 的一侧大小为 <span class="math inline">\(n - s_v\)</span>，贡献为 <span class="math inline">\((n - s_v)\cdot d\)</span></li>
</ul>
<p>于是得到转移</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(m_v = m_u + (n - 2\,s_v)\cdot (a_u \oplus a_v)\)</span></p>
